snippet.title: What Does the Bible Say About Feeling Lonely?
snippet.description: Recent reports have come out that loneliness can be more detrimental to your health that smoking and being obese. But do to the pandemic, loneliness is on the rise across the globe. What does the Bible tell us about loneliness? We take a look at Mark 1 to find out.
